Keyboard
W A S D or arrow keys: move · E: interact · Shift: sprint · Space: jump · Escape: pause. Drag the world to turn the camera.

Touch
Left stick: move. Drag the right side: look around. Tap Run to toggle sprint, ↑ to jump, and the interaction prompt to talk.
